clarifications: Use net external force for a defined closed system in an inertial frame; constant total mass for M*aCOM=Fext. Open mass-transfer systems require momentum flux, not an unqualified rocket F=m*a claim.
Impulse is a momentum change, not force itself; integration constants and initial momentum are retained.
Momentum conservation is independent of kinetic-energy conservation; collision response is the next section, not inferred from this chapter.
Free rigid motion decomposes into translation of COM plus rotation about COM, but need not rotate without tumbling or precession.
Model origin and physics COM are distinct; transform the local COM offset with the actual orientation before subtracting it.
The Earth/person/fan analogies and Earth-Moon orbit are simplified systems, not measured contemporary celestial dynamics.
No heavy-object throwing demonstration is requested or created; original figure observations remain pending.
